import pytesseract
from PIL import Image
import openpyxl

# Open the invoice image and run OCR
img = Image.open("uploads/invoice.png")
text = pytesseract.image_to_string(img)

print("=== OCR TEXT ===")
print(text)
print("================")

# Create a new Excel workbook and write the OCR text
wb = openpyxl.Workbook()
ws = wb.active
ws.title = "Invoice OCR"

# Write each line of the OCR output into a separate row in column A
lines = text.split("\\n")
for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
    ws.cell(row=i, column=1, value=line)

output_path = "output/invoice_ocr.xlsx"
import os
os.makedirs("output", exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
print(f"Excel file saved to {output_path}")
